episodes.title: What is Engineering?
episodes.description: Introduce engineering's major disciplines and the kinds of problems they address.

episodes.title: Civil Engineering
episodes.description: Explore structural design, construction, city planning, transportation, and sanitation within civil engineering.

episodes.title: Mechanical Engineering
episodes.description: Trace mechanical engineering from steam power through aircraft, robotics, and biomechanics.

episodes.title: The History of Electrical Engineering
episodes.description: Follow electrical engineering through telecommunications, power, lighting, and computers.

episodes.title: The History of Chemical Engineering
episodes.description: Trace chemical engineering from early industrial chemistry to refining, renewable energy, biotechnology, and medicines.

episodes.title: Biomedical & Industrial Engineering
episodes.description: Explore the origins and fundamentals of industrial, biomedical, and biological engineering.

episodes.title: The Law of Conservation
episodes.description: Analyze conservation in systems through conversion, accumulation, generation, and consumption.

episodes.title: Reversibility & Irreversibility
episodes.description: Compare reversible and irreversible processes while using efficiency to assess heat and work.

episodes.title: The First & Zeroth Laws of Thermodynamics
episodes.description: Explore thermal equilibrium, energy conservation, and processes that simplify thermodynamic analysis.

episodes.title: Why We Can’t Invent a Perfect Engine
episodes.description: Use the second thermodynamic law and Carnot's cycle to understand limits on engine efficiency.

episodes.title: Heat Engines, Refrigerators, & Cycles
episodes.description: Explore cycles in engines, refrigeration, and heat pumps alongside phase diagrams and energy resources.

episodes.title: Stress, Strain & Quicksand
episodes.description: Investigate fluid behavior through viscosity, scale, transfers, stresses, and flow conditions.

episodes.title: Fluid Flow & Equipment
episodes.description: Apply Bernoulli's relationship between pressure and speed to flowing fluids and real equipment.

episodes.title: Heat Transfer
episodes.description: Compare conduction, convection, and radiation as mechanisms moving thermal energy.

episodes.title: How Not to Set Your Pizza on Fire
episodes.description: Compare heat-exchanger designs and use calculations to select equipment for practical needs.

episodes.title: Drugs, Dyes, & Mass Transfer
episodes.description: Investigate molecular diffusion and the forces that drive material transfer using Fick's relationship.

episodes.title: Mass Separation
episodes.description: Compare distillation, solvent extraction, and reverse osmosis for separating substances.

episodes.title: Reaching Breaking Point – Materials, Stresses, & Toughness
episodes.description: Use stress-strain relationships to compare elasticity, toughness, hardness, creep, and fatigue.

episodes.title: Metals & Ceramics
episodes.description: Explore the properties and applications of metals, alloys, ceramics, and related materials.

episodes.title: The Polymer Explosion
episodes.description: Trace polymer development and the varied uses of repeating molecular chains.

episodes.title: Electrical Power, Conductors, & Your Dream Home
episodes.description: Compare electrical conductors and insulators, including materials used to generate heat and light.

episodes.title: Silicon, Semiconductors, & Solar Cells
episodes.description: Explore doped silicon and how semiconductor junctions enable diodes, transistors, and solar cells.

episodes.title: The Mighty Power of Nanomaterials
episodes.description: Investigate size-dependent properties of nanoscale materials and questions requiring further research.

episodes.title: Biomaterials
episodes.description: Explore body-compatible materials, their structures and coatings, and the importance of testing safety.

episodes.title: Cheese, Catastrophes, & Process Control
episodes.description: Use cheese production to compare feedback, feedforward, and combined process-control strategies.

episodes.title: Skyscrapers, Statics, & Dynamics
episodes.description: Analyze structures through forces, torque, equilibrium, and free-body diagrams.

episodes.title: Engineering Ethics
episodes.description: Apply professional codes and ethical theories to real engineering dilemmas.

episodes.title: Flirting With Disaster – The Importance of Safety
episodes.description: Compare workplace and public safety while exploring hazard analysis, alarms, and safety culture.

episodes.title: Preventing Flint – Environmental Engineering
episodes.description: Investigate engineering approaches to water, air, noise, and waste-related environmental problems.

episodes.title: The Engineering Challenges of Renewable Energy
episodes.description: Compare renewable technologies and the practical challenges of adopting them more widely.

episodes.title: The Future of Clean Energy
episodes.description: Explore biomass, hydrogen fuel cells, nuclear power, and proposed future energy sources.

episodes.title: Why It’s So Hard To Make Better Batteries
episodes.description: Investigate battery discharge, recharging, voltage changes, and efforts to improve performance.

episodes.title: How Engineering Robots Works
episodes.description: Explore how sensors, moving components, and computers let robots perform tasks.

episodes.title: To The Moon & Mars – Aerospace Engineering
episodes.description: Compare engineering for aircraft and spacecraft, including propulsion and human survival in space.

episodes.title: Computer Engineering & the End of Moore’s Law
episodes.description: Distinguish hardware and software while exploring compact computers and computer-assisted design and manufacturing.

episodes.title: How to Engineer Health – Drug Discovery & Delivery
episodes.description: Explore drug discovery, targeted delivery, disease detection, and synthetic biology.

episodes.title: Smart Tattoos & Tiny Robots
episodes.description: Investigate implantable medical devices and challenges involving compatibility, power, connectivity, packaging, and delivery.

episodes.title: Changing the Blueprints of Life – Genetic Engineering
episodes.description: Trace genetic intervention from selective breeding to DNA editing and optogenetics.

episodes.title: Mass-Producing Ice Cream with Food Engineering
episodes.description: Explore how processing, packaging, safety, and thermodynamics address the challenges of perishable foods.

episodes.title: How the Leaning Tower of Pisa Was Saved
episodes.description: Investigate foundations, soil properties, load-bearing capacity, and responses to earthquake stresses.

episodes.title: Why Moving People is Complicated
episodes.description: Explore transportation design through signaling, traffic patterns, user behavior, and system improvements.

episodes.title: YouTube Couldn’t Exist Without Communications & Signal Processing
episodes.description: Trace communication and signal processing through codes, limited bandwidth, noise, and digital systems.

episodes.title: How Seawater Sabotages Ships
episodes.description: Investigate marine design challenges including corrosion, organisms, and transferring large structures into water.

episodes.title: Building a Desalination Plant from Scratch
episodes.description: Follow design synthesis, small-scale testing, and iterative improvement through a desalination project.

episodes.title: How To Become An Engineer
episodes.description: Explore educational steps and possible career paths for becoming an engineer.

episodes.title: The Biggest Problems We’re Facing Today & The Future of Engineering
episodes.description: Apply the course's ideas to major current problems and consider engineering's possible future directions.
